description: This file is a shell script for testing repository permissions and Access Control Lists (ACLs). It sets up a test environment to verify ACL configurations, particularly using 'setfacl' and 'getfacl', and includes various test cases to ensure ACLs are correctly applied during repository operations.

methods.name: check_perms_and_acl
methods.description: Function to verify correct ACL permissions on a specified file, including user and group permissions and mask.
